name: @aiapp-server/server
description: Write AI App Server handlers in JavaScript or TypeScript: the Node.js worker runtime and SDK (app.models, app.kv, app.vectors, jobs, events, workflows, guardrails).

scripts.build: npm run proto && tsc -p . && esbuild src/runtime.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/aiapp-runtime.mjs
